The scaffold listed the correspondence and the first isomorphism theorem but not the extension theorem between them.

Scaffold prediction not used. The normalization to a pointed homeomorphism at step 2.1 is a coordinate permutation followed by an explicit shear-and-scale A, whose inverse is written out and whose continuity is checked componentwise ([L5]). Author-side addition. Step 1.1 applies the invariant-factor decomposition directly to the finitely generated torsion F[x]-module V_T and then rules out a free summand, since a nonzero element of F[x]^s would have zero annihilator. Step 2.1 converts convexity of g = log Gamma into monotonicity of g' and then upgrades it to strict monotonicity by ruling out an affine piece; that conversion is exactly the differentiable-convexity criterion ([F5] = thm-differentiable-convex-functions-and-monotone-derivatives).
